settings.title: Pati Settings
settings.characterHelp: To add your own character, open the folder, drop a pack folder into it, then press Reload. The pack format is described in the README.
settings.reminderPlaceholder: What should I remind you of?
chat.noServer: I couldn't reach the local AI ({url}). Is llama.cpp, Ollama or LM Studio running? You can change the address in Settings > AI.
chat.noModel: The server is running but has no model loaded.
settings.aiHelp: Connects to llama.cpp (llama-server), Ollama or LM Studio running on your computer; the model runs on your machine. An 8-9B model is recommended.
chat.badKey: That key didn't work ({url}). Could you type the right one?
settings.aiNeedsKey: Found {url}, but it wants an API key. Enter it below.
chat.needKey: I found the local server ({url}), but it wants an API key. Type it below and I'll save it and resend your message.
settings.aiServersHelp: Pati uses the first server on the list that is running. Put a smart, big model on top and a small, fast one below it.
settings.memoryEnabled: Remember what you tell it about yourself
settings.memoryEmpty: Nothing remembered yet. When you talk about yourself in chat, it shows up here.
settings.memoryClearConfirm: Delete everything Pati remembers about you?
settings.toolClipboard: Can read the clipboard ("summarize what I copied")
settings.toolWeb: Can look things up online (weather, Wikipedia)
settings.toolsHelp: Setting reminders and memory are always on and never leave your computer. With the online tool on, requests go only to Open-Meteo for weather and to Wikipedia.
settings.brainHelp: Pati keeps chats, daily summaries and what it remembers about you in this folder as plain Markdown. Open it in Obsidian to read or edit it; whatever you change in Memory.md, Pati remembers that way.
settings.brainNotVault: Folder opened. To see it in Obsidian, choose "Open folder as vault" once and pick this folder; after that this button opens Obsidian directly.
confirm.open_website: Shall I open {what} in your browser?
settings.toolActions: Can do things on the computer (open apps and websites, music and volume, folders, notes)
settings.proBriefing: Short briefing when I arrive in the morning
settings.proNight: A word when I am up very late
settings.proBreaks: Suggest a break after 90 minutes without one
intent.failed: I couldn't do that, something went wrong.
intent.note: Noted: "{text}". It is in Notes.md in the brain.
intent.previous: Went back to the previous track.
intent.mute: Pressed mute; say "mute" again to unmute.
media.play_pause: Shall I pause or resume the music
media.next: Shall I skip to the next track
media.previous: Shall I go back a track
media.volume_up: Shall I turn the volume up
media.volume_down: Shall I turn the volume down
intent.noApp: I could not find an installed app called "{name}". Could you try another name?
intent.noPath: I could not find a file or folder called "{name}" (I looked on the Desktop, Documents and Downloads).
intent.pathMany: There are a few: {names}. Which one should I open? Please name it a bit more clearly.
confirm.append_file: Shall I add to the end of "{what}"?
confirm.undo: Undo the last move or rename?
intent.fileAppended: Added it to the end of "{name}".
intent.pathCopied: Copied the path of "{name}" to the clipboard.
intent.err.text: I can only write plain text files (txt, md, csv).
intent.err.name: That name will not work, could you give another?
intent.err.exists: Something with that name already exists; I never overwrite.
intent.err.program: I do not touch programs or scripts.
intent.err.big: That file is too big, I will leave it.
intent.err.cannotUndo: I could not undo it: the file changed in the meantime.
voice.heardNothing: I didn't hear anything. Try again?
voice.noMic: I can't reach the microphone. Is it plugged in, and is microphone access on in Windows?
voice.noWhisper: I need whisper.cpp to turn your voice into text. Pick whisper-cli.exe in Settings > Talking by voice.
voice.noModel: I found whisper.cpp but no model file. Pick a ggml-*.bin in Settings > Talking by voice.
voice.failed: I couldn't write down what you said; whisper.cpp reported an error.
settings.voiceEnabled: Talk by voice with a shortcut
settings.voiceShortcutHelp: Press, speak; Pati stops listening when you pause (or press again). For example: Control+Shift+Space, Alt+F9.
settings.voiceShortcutTaken: This shortcut could not be used: it is invalid or another app holds it.
settings.voiceHelp: What you say is turned into text on your computer by whisper.cpp and sent nowhere. If you don't have it, download a release from github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp and add a multilingual model such as ggml-small.bin (models ending in .en only know English).
focus.started: OK, {m} minutes of focus. I'll stay quiet and tell you when it's over.
focus.stopped: Focus ended. We can talk again.
focus.focusDone: Focus time's up, nice work! Take 5 minutes: stand up, drink some water, rest your eyes.
focus.longFocusDone: Four rounds done, great job! Time for a long 15-minute break.
focus.breakDone: Break's over. Just say "focus" for another round.
confirm.screen: Shall I take a screenshot and show it to the model? It is not saved anywhere.
screen.noVision: I could not find a model that can see. You need a vision model: start one like Qwen2.5-VL or Gemma 3 in llama.cpp with its --mmproj file, or pull qwen2.5vl in Ollama.
menu.lookAsk: Look at my screen: what do you see? Keep it short.
settings.physics: Fall onto windows, and can be thrown
model.offer: I couldn't find a local AI on your computer. Shall I download and set up Pati-4B? About 3.4 GB, it may take a while depending on your connection.
model.declined: OK. You can install it later from Settings > AI > Pati-4B.
model.ready: I'm ready! We can talk now.
model.busy: Pati-4B is still downloading, let's talk when it's done. {progress}
model.error.disk: Not enough disk space: about {detail} GB free is needed. Free some up and say "yes" again and I'll carry on where I stopped.
model.error.network: The download was interrupted ({detail}). Check your connection and try again; I'll carry on where I stopped.
model.error.checksum: The downloaded file was corrupt ({detail}), so I deleted it. Try again and I'll download it anew.
model.error.extract: Couldn't unpack llama.cpp ({detail}). Try again and I'll retry.
model.error.start: Pati-4B is installed but would not start ({detail}). Log file: {log}
settings.modelRemoveConfirm: Delete Pati-4B and llama.cpp from disk? (about 3.4 GB)
model.stopped: I stopped the download. I can carry on where I left off whenever you like.
